concept: What an AI agent is doing, in one quiet row: a glyph and a word per state, the task in a line, its steps, and the one thing the reader can do now.

default_to_avoid.pattern: an agent status as a coloured pill that pulses
default_to_avoid.kind: agent status, AI status, progress indicator for an agent, task status
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured pulse says nothing about what the agent is doing and fails without colour; Pane says the state in a word with its own glyph and lists the steps

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: each state has its own glyph: dots, a turning arc, a clock, a check, an octagon

derivation.consequence: labels and names exist for assistive tech even when hidden visually
derivation.form: the state is a word before the task, read once as a polite status

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: working turns and thinking breathes, slowly, and both stop under reduced motion

options: A glyph, a word and the steps
variants.picked: A glyph, a word and the steps
variants.reason: A says what and where without colour (P6). B rests on hue. C says nothing about the task.

root.why: a quiet tinted row on the pane with its edge

line.why: the glyph, the words and the action share one row

glyph.why: the state's glyph sits on the first line of text

thinking.why: thinking is three dots in the secondary tone

working.why: working is a turning arc in the primary tone

waiting.why: waiting for the reader takes the warning mark, because the reader must act

done.why: done takes the positive mark beside its check, so finished reads by shape too

failed.why: failed takes the critical mark beside its octagon, so a failure reads by shape too

text.why: the words take the free width between the glyph and the action

title.why: the task reads in the primary tone, in the reader's own words

word.why: the state word is semibold so it is found first

meta.why: the step count and time are caption size in tabular figures

action.why: the one thing the reader can do sits at the end

steps.why: the steps are a short list under the line, aligned with the words

step.why: each step is a line of label size

dot.why: a step's dot is a ring until done, filled when done or current

sr.why: the state word is read before the line, so the state is never colour or shape alone

data-state=current.why: the current step comes up to the primary tone and medium weight, and is marked current

data-state=done.why: a done step's dot is filled in the secondary tone

data-state=failed.why: a failed step's dot takes the critical mark and the word Failed is read

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: under reduced motion nothing turns, blinks or breathes, and the word carries the news

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks, so every part stays findable

@turn.why: working turns once a second or so, steady enough to read as busy and never frantic

@breathe.why: thinking breathes slowly between full and faint, so it reads as waiting rather than working
